transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
I want a doctor's appointment, Dr. Smith.
Happy to help. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Hannah Brooks, May twentieth, nineteen ninety-four.
Thanks, Hannah. Are you a new or an existing patient?
What insurance provider do you have?
Dr. Smith has Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
I'm sorry, Dr. Smith only sees new patients on Monday and Wednesday. Would Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM work?
Booked: Hannah Brooks, Wednesday at 2 PM. A confirmation will be sent. Goodbye.
